# M1-08 — Initial Risk Register

## Labels
`docs`, `milestone-1`, `priority-critical`

## Milestone
Milestone 1 — Engineering Foundation & Requirements Baseline

## Tasks
- [ ] Identify project-specific risks (requirements, people/skills, technology, security, integration, deployment, cost, schedule, quality, dependencies, AI)
- [ ] Assign each risk a unique ID, description and cause (avoid vague entries like "coding problems")
- [ ] Score probability and impact, and derive a priority
- [ ] Define mitigation and contingency for each risk
- [ ] Assign an owner and status to each risk
- [ ] Identify the single highest-priority risk and prepare its defence
- [ ] Integrate the live Risk Register into PED v1.0

## Acceptance Criteria
- Each risk entry has: ID, description, cause, probability, impact, priority, mitigation, contingency, owner, status.
- Risks are specific enough to be actionable, not generic.
- Team can defend the highest-priority risk and its mitigation/contingency in detail.
- Register is a live artefact, reviewable at each future milestone.
